description: This Java class implements a Tree Renderer based on Freemarker macros for rendering tree structures in a web UI, including boundary comments, nodes, labels, links, and images.

classes.name: MacroTreeRenderer
classes.description: Implements TreeStringRenderer to render tree structures using Freemarker macros, supporting boundary comments, node rendering, labels, links, and images.

methods.name: MacroTreeRenderer
methods.description: Constructor that loads the macro library template and initializes the Freemarker environment.

methods.name: executeMacro
methods.description: Renders a macro string within the Freemarker environment, handling exceptions.

methods.name: renderBeginningBoundaryComment
methods.description: Renders the beginning boundary comment for a widget.

methods.name: renderEndingBoundaryComment
methods.description: Renders the ending boundary comment for a widget.

methods.name: renderNodeBegin
methods.description: Renders the start of a tree node, including boundary comments and expand/collapse logic.

methods.name: renderNodeEnd
methods.description: Renders the end of a tree node, including boundary comments.

methods.name: renderLastElement
methods.description: Renders the last element in a node, typically closing tags.

methods.name: renderLabel
methods.description: Renders a label for a tree node.

methods.name: renderLink
methods.description: Renders a hyperlink with optional image.

methods.name: renderImage
methods.description: Renders an image with URL processing based on mode.

methods.name: getScreenStringRenderer
methods.description: Returns a ScreenStringRenderer if available in context.
